product_metadata.title: 2 Pack Extra Large Travel Laundry Bags, Heavy Duty Camp Laundry Bag, Rip-Stop Machine Washable Dirty Clothes Organizer Bag with Drawstring Closure (Green+Grey, 24"*36")
features: MATERIAL: The laundry bag is made of premium and thick nylon oxford with strong double stitching.It's strong,durable, rip-resistant and heavy-duty.Sturdy for hauling big laundry loads. Machine washable.
SIZE:Its extra large size (24"*36") allows it to hold a load of laundry with ease and meet all your requirement for storage.
DRAWSTING LOCKING CLOSURE:The laundry bag with drawstring can be sealed quickly and conveniently,will keep your stuff inside laundry bag and prevent spill of personal items after tie the knot.

PORTABLE AND FOLDABLE:The laundry bag is easy to be folded when not in use and can be used over and again for years.It is not only suitable for home use,but also suitable for travel, storage in college dorm, university dormitory, child's room.

MULTI-PURPOSE STORAGE BAG:Travel laundry bags not only can be used for laundry day, but also a good choice for seasonal clothes,toys,bedding, towels, sleeping bags, blankets, quilts, pillows and more as you want.Perfect choice for your.
